mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = p.id) AS case_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = p.id AND pc.result IS NOT NULL) AS executed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = p.id AND pc.result = 'passed') AS passed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = p.id AND pc.result = 'failed') AS failed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = p.id AND pc.result = 'blocked') AS blocked_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_case_run r WHERE r.plan_id = p.id AND r.bug_task_id IS NOT NULL) AS defect_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_plan (id, workspace_id, req_id, name, version_id, planned_start, planned_end, status, note, created_by, created_by_user_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{name}, #{versionId}, #{plannedStart}, #{plannedEnd}, #{status}, #{note}, #{createdBy}, #{createdByUserId})
mapper.update: UPDATE test_plan SET req_id = #{reqId}, name = #{name}, version_id = #{versionId}, planned_start = #{plannedStart}, planned_end = #{plannedEnd}, note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_plan WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
SELECT p.*, v.name AS version_name, FROM test_plan p LEFT JOIN project_version v ON v.id = p.version_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE test_plan SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM test_plan WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
DELETE FROM test_plan WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
